reports.title: Condensed Consolidated Interim Statements of Earnings and Comprehensive Income

guidance.heading: 2026 Outlook
section: The Company has updated its 2026 outlook as follows:

•Mount Milligan Mine - lowering estimate for all-in sustaining costs on a by-product basisNG, driven by strong copper credits. Mount Milligan Mine has also adjusted anticipated tax expense upward to align with higher revenue resulting from favourable gold and copper prices. Lastly, the Mount Milligan Mine has increased its DDA estimate to better reflect the current mine plan.
•Langeloth Facility - raised its guidance for net earnings and adjusted EBITDANG as it expects to benefit from high molybdenum prices throughout 2026.
•Corporate - increased full year corporate G&A guidance to reflect a number of small factors including consulting and legal fees.

Except for the changes highlighted above, the Company’s outlook is unchanged as presented in the MD&A for the three and six months ended June 30, 2026. The Company’s full year 2026 outlook, and comparative actual results for the nine months ended September 30, 2026 of certain operating metrics are set out in the sections below. The Company notes that the ongoing shifts and uncertainty around the conflict in the Middle East and volatility of fuel prices may have an impact on the results of the Company’s operations in 2026, but at present these impacts are not expected to be material at the consolidated level.
